raw: Act 5, Scene 3 — A churchyard; in it a Monument belonging to the Capulets

sentences.en: A churchyard; in it a Monument belonging to the Capulets
sentences.ko: 교회 묘지, 캐퓰릿 가문의 무덤

summary.en: At the tomb, Romeo kills Paris and drinks the poison. Juliet wakes, finds Romeo dead, and kills herself. The two families finally make peace.
summary.ko: 무덤에서 로미오는 패리스를 죽이고 독약을 마신다. 깨어난 줄리엣은 죽은 로미오를 보고 스스로 목숨을 끊는다. 마침내 두 집안은 화해한다.

raw: Enter Paris, and his Page bearing flowers and a torch.

sentences.en: Paris enters with his page, who carries flowers and a torch.
sentences.ko: 패리스가 꽃과 횃불을 든 시동과 함께 들어온다.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
Give me thy torch, boy. Hence and stand aloof.
Yet put it out, for I would not be seen.
Under yond yew tree lay thee all along,
Holding thy ear close to the hollow ground;
So shall no foot upon the churchyard tread,
Being loose, unfirm, with digging up of graves,
But thou shalt hear it. Whistle then to me,
As signal that thou hear’st something approach.
Give me those flowers. Do as I bid thee, go.

sentences.en: Give me your torch, boy.
sentences.ko: 얘야, 횃불을 내게 다오.

sentences.en: Go and stand far away.
sentences.ko: 저 멀리 가서 서 있어라.

sentences.en: Put it out because I do not want to be seen.
sentences.ko: 들키고 싶지 않으니 불을 꺼라.

sentences.en: Lie down flat under that yew tree.
sentences.ko: 저 주목나무 아래에 납작하게 엎드려라.

sentences.en: Hold your ear close to the ground.
sentences.ko: 귀를 땅에 바짝 대라.

sentences.en: The ground is loose from digging graves.
sentences.ko: 무덤을 파느라 땅이 물러져 있다.

sentences.en: No one can walk in the churchyard without you hearing it.
sentences.ko: 누가 교회 마당을 걸으면 네가 꼭 듣게 될 것이다.

sentences.en: Whistle to me then.
sentences.ko: 그러면 내게 휘파람을 불어라.

sentences.en: Whistle as a signal that you hear something coming.
sentences.ko: 무언가 오는 소리가 들리면 신호로 휘파람을 불어라.

sentences.en: Give me those flowers.
sentences.ko: 그 꽃들을 내게 다오.

sentences.en: Do what I tell you and go.
sentences.ko: 내가 시키는 대로 하고 물러가거라.

speaker: PAGE
raw:
I am almost afraid to stand alone
Here in the churchyard; yet I will adventure.

sentences.en: I am almost afraid to stand alone here in the churchyard.
sentences.ko: 교회 마당에 혼자 서 있자니 좀 무섭다.

sentences.en: Still, I will take the risk.
sentences.ko: 그래도 해 봐야지.

raw: Retires.

sentences.en: The page moves away and hides.
sentences.ko: 시동이 멀어져 숨는다.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
Sweet flower, with flowers thy bridal bed I strew.
O woe, thy canopy is dust and stones,
Which with sweet water nightly I will dew,
Or wanting that, with tears distill’d by moans.
The obsequies that I for thee will keep,
Nightly shall be to strew thy grave and weep.

sentences.en: Sweet flower, I scatter flowers on your wedding bed.
sentences.ko: 꽃 같은 그대여, 그대의 신방에 꽃을 뿌리노라.

sentences.en: Oh no, your canopy is only dust and stones.
sentences.ko: 아아, 그대의 침대 덮개는 먼지와 돌뿐이구나.

sentences.en: I will water it with sweet water every night.
sentences.ko: 매일 밤 향긋한 물로 적셔 주리라.

sentences.en: If I lack that, I will use tears from my crying.
sentences.ko: 그 물이 없으면 내 눈물로 적시리라.

sentences.en: Every night I will come to your grave.
sentences.ko: 매일 밤 네 무덤으로 찾아가리라.

sentences.en: I will scatter flowers on it and cry.
sentences.ko: 꽃을 뿌리며 울어주마.

raw: The Page whistles.

sentences.en: The Page whistles.
sentences.ko: 시동이 휘파람을 분다.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
The boy gives warning something doth approach.
What cursed foot wanders this way tonight,
To cross my obsequies and true love’s rite?
What, with a torch! Muffle me, night, awhile.

sentences.en: The boy signals that something is coming.
sentences.ko: 시동이 무언가 다가온다고 신호를 보내는구나.

sentences.en: What cursed foot wanders this way tonight?
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 어떤 저주받은 발길이 이쪽으로 오는 거지?

sentences.en: It comes to interrupt my funeral rites and my ceremony of true love.
sentences.ko: 내 장례 의식과 진실한 사랑의 예식을 방해하러 오는구나.

sentences.en: What? It has a torch!
sentences.ko: 뭐야? 횃불을 들었잖아!

sentences.en: Night, hide me for a while.
sentences.ko: 밤아, 나를 잠시 숨겨다오.

raw: Retires.

sentences.en: Paris steps back and hides.
sentences.ko: 패리스가 뒤로 물러나 몸을 숨긴다.

raw: Enter Romeo and Balthasar with a torch, mattock, &c.

sentences.en: Romeo and Balthasar enter with a torch, a pickaxe and other tools.
sentences.ko: 로미오와 발타자르가 횃불과 곡괭이, 그리고 다른 도구들을 들고 들어온다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Give me that mattock and the wrenching iron.
Hold, take this letter; early in the morning
See thou deliver it to my lord and father.
Give me the light; upon thy life I charge thee,
Whate’er thou hear’st or seest, stand all aloof
And do not interrupt me in my course.
Why I descend into this bed of death
Is partly to behold my lady’s face,
But chiefly to take thence from her dead finger
A precious ring, a ring that I must use
In dear employment. Therefore hence, be gone.
But if thou jealous dost return to pry
In what I further shall intend to do,
By heaven I will tear thee joint by joint,
And strew this hungry churchyard with thy limbs.
The time and my intents are savage-wild;
More fierce and more inexorable far
Than empty tigers or the roaring sea.

sentences.en: Give me that pickaxe and the crowbar.
sentences.ko: 그 곡괭이와 쇠지렛대를 이리 다오.

sentences.en: Wait, take this letter.
sentences.ko: 잠깐, 이 편지를 받아라.

sentences.en: Deliver it to my lord and father early in the morning.
sentences.ko: 아침 일찍 우리 아버님께 전해라.

sentences.en: Give me the light.
sentences.ko: 불을 내게 넘겨라.

sentences.en: I charge you on your life.
sentences.ko: 네 목숨을 걸고 명한다.

sentences.en: Whatever you hear or see, stay away.
sentences.ko: 무엇이든 듣거나 보더라도 멀리 떨어져 있어라.

sentences.en: Do not stop me from what I am doing.
sentences.ko: 내가 하는 일을 방해하지 마라.

sentences.en: I go into this bed of death partly to see my lady's face.
sentences.ko: 이 죽음의 침대로 내려가는 건 한편으로는 내 아내의 얼굴을 보기 위해서다.

sentences.en: But mostly I want to take a precious ring from her dead finger.
sentences.ko: 하지만 무엇보다 그녀의 죽은 손가락에서 소중한 반지를 빼기 위해서다.

sentences.en: I must use this ring for an important task.
sentences.ko: 이 반지는 중요한 일에 써야만 한다.

sentences.en: Therefore, go away now.
sentences.ko: 그러니 이제 물러가라.

sentences.en: You may be curious and try to find out what I plan to do next.
sentences.ko: 혹시 궁금해서 내가 무엇을 하려는지 엿보려 할지도 모르겠다.

sentences.en: If you do, I swear by heaven that I will tear you apart.
sentences.ko: 그런다면 하늘에 맹세코 너를 갈기갈기 찢어

sentences.en: I will scatter your body parts across this hungry churchyard.
sentences.ko: 이 굶주린 교회 마당에 뿌려 버리겠다.

sentences.en: The time and my plans are wild.
sentences.ko: 지금 이 시간도, 내 뜻도 사납다.

sentences.en: They are much more fierce and unstoppable than hungry tigers or the roaring sea.
sentences.ko: 그것들은 굶주린 호랑이나 포효하는 바다보다 훨씬 더 사납고 막을 수 없다.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw: I will be gone, sir, and not trouble you.

sentences.en: I will leave now, sir, and not bother you.
sentences.ko: 이제 물러가겠습니다, 주인님. 방해하지 않겠습니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
So shalt thou show me friendship. Take thou that.
Live, and be prosperous, and farewell, good fellow.

sentences.en: That way you will show me friendship.
sentences.ko: 그래야 네가 내게 우정을 보이는 거다.

sentences.en: Take that.
sentences.ko: 이걸 받아라.

sentences.en: Live and be successful, and goodbye, good fellow.
sentences.ko: 잘 살고 성공해라. 잘 있거라, 착한 친구야.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
For all this same, I’ll hide me hereabout.
His looks I fear, and his intents I doubt.

sentences.en: All the same, I will hide nearby.
sentences.ko: 그래도 근처에 숨어 있어야겠다.

sentences.en: I fear his look, and I doubt his intentions.
sentences.ko: 주인님 눈빛이 무섭고, 무슨 생각을 하시는지 모르겠다.

raw: Retires

sentences.en: Balthasar hides nearby.
sentences.ko: 발타자르는 근처에 숨는다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Thou detestable maw, thou womb of death,
Gorg’d with the dearest morsel of the earth,
Thus I enforce thy rotten jaws to open,

sentences.en: You hateful tomb, you hungry mouth of death!
sentences.ko: 이 가증스러운 무덤아, 죽음의 굶주린 아가리야!

sentences.en: You have swallowed the most precious thing on earth.
sentences.ko: 너는 세상에서 가장 소중한 것을 삼켜버렸다.

sentences.en: I force your rotten jaws to open like this.
sentences.ko: 네 썩은 턱을 이렇게 억지로 벌리마.

raw: Breaking open the door of the monument.

sentences.en: Romeo breaks open the door of the tomb.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 무덤 문을 부수고 들어간다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw: And in despite, I’ll cram thee with more food.

sentences.en: And to spite you, I will fill you with more dead.
sentences.ko: 너를 골려 주려고 더 많은 시체로 채워 주마.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
This is that banish’d haughty Montague
That murder’d my love’s cousin,—with which grief,
It is supposed, the fair creature died,—
And here is come to do some villainous shame
To the dead bodies. I will apprehend him.

sentences.en: This is that banished and proud Montague.
sentences.ko: 저건 추방당한 오만한 몬태규다.

sentences.en: He murdered my love's cousin.
sentences.ko: 내 사랑의 사촌을 죽인 자다.

sentences.en: It is said that she died from that grief.
sentences.ko: 그녀가 그 슬픔 때문에 죽었다고들 한다.

sentences.en: He has come here to do something shameful to the dead bodies.
sentences.ko: 저자가 시체들에게 욕된 짓을 하러 여기 왔구나.

sentences.en: I will arrest him.
sentences.ko: 저자를 체포하겠다.

raw: Advances.

sentences.en: Paris steps forward.
sentences.ko: 패리스가 앞으로 나선다.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
Stop thy unhallow’d toil, vile Montague.
Can vengeance be pursu’d further than death?
Condemned villain, I do apprehend thee.
Obey, and go with me, for thou must die.

sentences.en: Stop your unholy work, vile Montague.
sentences.ko: 그 더러운 짓을 멈춰라, 비열한 몬태규.

sentences.en: Can revenge be pursued further than death?
sentences.ko: 죽은 뒤까지 복수를 할 셈이냐?

sentences.en: You condemned villain, I arrest you.
sentences.ko: 사형을 선고받은 악당아, 너를 체포한다.

sentences.en: Obey me and come with me, for you must die.
sentences.ko: 순순히 따라와라, 너는 죽어야 한다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
I must indeed; and therefore came I hither.
Good gentle youth, tempt not a desperate man.
Fly hence and leave me. Think upon these gone;
Let them affright thee. I beseech thee, youth,
Put not another sin upon my head
By urging me to fury. O be gone.
By heaven I love thee better than myself;
For I come hither arm’d against myself.
Stay not, be gone, live, and hereafter say,
A madman’s mercy bid thee run away.

sentences.en: Yes, I must die, and that is why I came here.
sentences.ko: 그래, 나는 죽어야 한다. 그래서 여기 왔다.

sentences.en: Good young man, do not push a desperate man.
sentences.ko: 착한 젊은이, 절망한 사람을 건드리지 마라.

sentences.en: Run away and leave me.
sentences.ko: 달아나서 나를 내버려 둬라.

sentences.en: Think about these dead people and let them frighten you.
sentences.ko: 여기 죽은 이들을 생각하고 겁을 먹어라.

sentences.en: I beg you, young man, do not add another sin to my head by making me angry.
sentences.ko: 부탁이다, 젊은이, 나를 화나게 해서 내 머리에 죄를 하나 더 얹게 하지 마라.

sentences.en: Please, go away.
sentences.ko: 제발, 가거라.

sentences.en: By heaven, I love you more than myself.
sentences.ko: 하늘에 맹세코, 나는 나 자신보다 너를 더 아낀다.

sentences.en: I came here armed against myself.
sentences.ko: 나는 나 자신을 해치려고 무기를 들고 왔다.

sentences.en: Do not stay; go away and live.
sentences.ko: 머물지 말고, 가서 살아라.

sentences.en: Later, tell others that a madman's mercy told you to run away.
sentences.ko: 나중에, 미친 자가 자비를 베풀어 도망치라고 했다고 말해라.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
I do defy thy conjuration,
And apprehend thee for a felon here.

sentences.en: I reject your pleading, and I arrest you as a criminal here.
sentences.ko: 애원 따위는 필요 없다. 여기서 너를 죄인으로 체포하겠다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw: Wilt thou provoke me? Then have at thee, boy!

sentences.en: Will you provoke me?
sentences.ko: 끝내 나를 건드리겠다는 거냐?

sentences.en: Then come at me, boy!
sentences.ko: 그럼 덤벼라, 애송이!

raw: They fight.

sentences.en: They fight.
sentences.ko: 그들이 싸운다.

speaker: PAGE
raw: O lord, they fight! I will go call the watch.

sentences.en: Oh lord, they are fighting!
sentences.ko: 세상에, 싸우고 있잖아!

sentences.en: I will go call the watch, the night guards.
sentences.ko: 가서 야경꾼들을 불러와야겠다.

raw: Exit.

speaker: PARIS
raw: O, I am slain!

sentences.en: Oh, I am killed!
sentences.ko: 아, 내가 죽는구나!

raw: Falls.

sentences.en: Paris falls.
sentences.ko: 패리스가 쓰러진다.

speaker: PARIS
raw:
If thou be merciful,
Open the tomb, lay me with Juliet.

sentences.en: If you are merciful, open the tomb.
sentences.ko: 자비롭다면 무덤을 열어다오.

sentences.en: Put me with Juliet.
sentences.ko: 나를 줄리엣 곁에 묻어다오.

raw: Dies.

sentences.en: Paris dies.
sentences.ko: 패리스가 죽는다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
In faith, I will. Let me peruse this face.
Mercutio’s kinsman, noble County Paris!
What said my man, when my betossed soul
Did not attend him as we rode? I think
He told me Paris should have married Juliet.
Said he not so? Or did I dream it so?
Or am I mad, hearing him talk of Juliet,
To think it was so? O, give me thy hand,
One writ with me in sour misfortune’s book.
I’ll bury thee in a triumphant grave.
A grave? O no, a lantern, slaught’red youth,
For here lies Juliet, and her beauty makes
This vault a feasting presence full of light.
Death, lie thou there, by a dead man interr’d.

sentences.en: I will do that. Let me look at this face.
sentences.ko: 그렇게 하마. 이 얼굴을 좀 보자.

sentences.en: Mercutio's relative, the noble Count Paris!
sentences.ko: 머큐쇼의 친척, 고귀한 패리스 백작이구나!

sentences.en: What did my man say when my lost soul did not listen to him while we rode?
sentences.ko: 말을 타고 오는 동안 넋이 나간 내가 귀담아듣지 않았는데, 내 하인이 뭐라고 했더라?

sentences.en: I think he told me Paris should have married Juliet.
sentences.ko: 그는 패리스가 줄리엣과 결혼했어야 했다고 말했던 것 같다.

sentences.en: Did he not say that, or did I dream it?
sentences.ko: 그가 그렇게 말했나, 아니면 내가 꿈을 꾼 건가?

sentences.en: Or am I mad for hearing him talk of Juliet and thinking it was true?
sentences.ko: 아니면 줄리엣에 대한 그의 말을 사실로 믿어버린 내가 미친 건가?

sentences.en: Give me your hand.
sentences.ko: 네 손을 내게 다오.

sentences.en: Your name is written with mine in the book of bad luck.
sentences.ko: 불운의 책에 네 이름이 내 이름과 함께 적혀 있다.

sentences.en: I will bury you in a triumphant grave.
sentences.ko: 너를 영광스러운 무덤에 묻어 주마.

sentences.en: A grave? Oh no, a lantern, murdered young man.
sentences.ko: 무덤이라고? 아니, 등불이다, 살해당한 젊은이여.

sentences.en: Juliet lies here.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 여기 누워 있다.

sentences.en: Her beauty makes this vault a party hall full of light.
sentences.ko: 그녀의 아름다움이 이 묘실을 빛으로 가득한 잔칫집으로 만든다.

sentences.en: Death, stay there, buried by a dead man.
sentences.ko: 죽은 이여, 죽은 사람의 손에 묻혀 거기 누워 있어라.

raw: Laying Paris in the monument.

sentences.en: Romeo lays Paris in the tomb.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 무덤에 패리스를 눕힌다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
How oft when men are at the point of death
Have they been merry! Which their keepers call
A lightning before death. O, how may I
Call this a lightning? O my love, my wife,
Death that hath suck’d the honey of thy breath,
Hath had no power yet upon thy beauty.
Thou art not conquer’d. Beauty’s ensign yet
Is crimson in thy lips and in thy cheeks,
And death’s pale flag is not advanced there.
Tybalt, liest thou there in thy bloody sheet?
O, what more favour can I do to thee
Than with that hand that cut thy youth in twain
To sunder his that was thine enemy?
Forgive me, cousin. Ah, dear Juliet,
Why art thou yet so fair? Shall I believe
That unsubstantial death is amorous;
And that the lean abhorred monster keeps
Thee here in dark to be his paramour?
For fear of that I still will stay with thee,
And never from this palace of dim night
Depart again. Here, here will I remain
With worms that are thy chambermaids. O, here
Will I set up my everlasting rest;
And shake the yoke of inauspicious stars
From this world-wearied flesh. Eyes, look your last.
Arms, take your last embrace! And, lips, O you
The doors of breath, seal with a righteous kiss
A dateless bargain to engrossing death.
Come, bitter conduct, come, unsavoury guide.
Thou desperate pilot, now at once run on
The dashing rocks thy sea-sick weary bark.
Here’s to my love!

sentences.en: How often have men been happy at the moment of death!
sentences.ko: 죽음의 순간에 행복을 맛본 이들이 얼마나 많았던가!

sentences.en: Their nurses call this a lightning before death.
sentences.ko: 간병하는 사람들은 이걸 죽기 전의 번개라고 부르지.

sentences.en: Oh, how can I call this a lightning?
sentences.ko: 아, 이걸 어찌 번개라 부르겠나?

sentences.en: Oh my love, my wife, death has taken the honey from your breath.
sentences.ko: 내 사랑, 내 아내여, 죽음이 당신 숨결의 꿀은 빨아 갔어도

sentences.en: But death has no power over your beauty yet.
sentences.ko: 당신의 아름다움에는 아직 아무 힘도 쓰지 못했어.

sentences.en: You are not conquered.
sentences.ko: 당신은 정복되지 않았어.

sentences.en: The sign of beauty is still red in your lips and cheeks.
sentences.ko: 아름다움의 흔적이 당신의 입술과 뺨에 여전히 붉게 남아있어.

sentences.en: Death's pale flag is not there.
sentences.ko: 죽음의 창백한 깃발은 보이지 않아.

sentences.en: Tybalt, do you lie there in your bloody sheet?
sentences.ko: 티볼트, 너는 피 묻은 수의를 입고 저기 누워 있느냐?

sentences.en: Oh, what more can I do for you?
sentences.ko: 아, 내가 너를 위해 무엇을 더 해 줄 수 있겠느냐?

sentences.en: I will use the same hand that cut your young life short to kill your enemy, myself.
sentences.ko: 네 젊은 목숨을 끊은 바로 이 손으로 네 원수, 곧 나 자신을 죽이겠다.

sentences.en: Forgive me, cousin.
sentences.ko: 용서해라, 사촌.

sentences.en: Ah, dear Juliet, why are you still so beautiful?
sentences.ko: 아, 사랑하는 줄리엣, 당신은 왜 아직도 이렇게 아름다워?

sentences.en: Should I believe that shadowy death is in love with you?
sentences.ko: 그림자 같은 죽음이 당신을 사랑한다고 믿어야 할까?

sentences.en: And that the thin, hated monster keeps you here in the dark as his lover?
sentences.ko: 그 여위고 가증스러운 괴물이 당신을 애인 삼아 이 어둠 속에 붙잡아 둔다고?

sentences.en: Because of that fear, I will stay with you.
sentences.ko: 그게 두려워서 나는 당신 곁에 있을 거야.

sentences.en: I will never leave this palace of dark night.
sentences.ko: 이 어두운 밤의 궁전을 절대 떠나지 않을 거야.

sentences.en: Here, I will stay with the worms that are your maids.
sentences.ko: 여기서 당신의 시녀인 벌레들과 함께 지낼 거야.

sentences.en: Here I will rest forever.
sentences.ko: 여기서 영원히 쉴 거야.

sentences.en: I will shake the weight of unlucky stars from this tired body.
sentences.ko: 이 지친 몸에서 불운한 별들의 무게를 털어내리라.

sentences.en: Eyes, look for the last time.
sentences.ko: 눈이여, 마지막으로 바라보아라.

sentences.en: Arms, give your last embrace!
sentences.ko: 팔아, 마지막으로 안아라!

sentences.en: And lips, oh you doors of breath, seal a deal with death with a holy kiss.
sentences.ko: 그리고 입술아, 숨결의 문들아, 성스러운 입맞춤으로 죽음과 계약을 맺어라.

sentences.en: It is a deal that never ends.
sentences.ko: 그것은 결코 끝나지 않을 계약이다.

sentences.en: Come, bitter poison, come, horrible guide.
sentences.ko: 오라, 쓰디쓴 독약아, 오라, 끔찍한 인도자여.

sentences.en: You desperate pilot, now crash my sea-sick, tired boat onto the rocks!
sentences.ko: 무모한 뱃사공아, 이제 뱃멀미에 지친 내 배를 바위에 부딪쳐 부숴라!

sentences.en: Here is to my love!
sentences.ko: 내 사랑을 위하여!

raw: Drinks.

sentences.en: Romeo drinks.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 약을 마신다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
O true apothecary!
Thy drugs are quick. Thus with a kiss I die.

sentences.en: Oh, honest apothecary, your drugs work quickly.
sentences.ko: 오, 정직한 약제사여, 약효가 참 빠르구나.

sentences.en: So, with a kiss, I die.
sentences.ko: 이렇게, 입맞춤과 함께 나는 죽는다.

raw: Dies.

sentences.en: Romeo dies.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 죽는다.

raw: Enter, at the other end of the Churchyard, Friar Lawrence, with a lantern, crow, and spade.

sentences.en: Friar Lawrence enters at the other end of the churchyard.
sentences.ko: 로런스 신부가 교회 마당 반대편에서 들어온다.

sentences.en: He carries a lantern, a crowbar, and a spade.
sentences.ko: 그는 등불과 지렛대, 그리고 삽을 들고 있다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Saint Francis be my speed. How oft tonight
Have my old feet stumbled at graves? Who’s there?
Who is it that consorts, so late, the dead?

sentences.en: May Saint Francis help me move quickly.
sentences.ko: 성 프란치스코여, 제 발걸음을 서두르게 도와주소서.

sentences.en: How many times tonight have my old feet tripped over graves?
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 이 늙은 발이 무덤에 몇 번이나 걸려 넘어졌던가?

sentences.en: Who is there?
sentences.ko: 거기 누구냐?

sentences.en: Who is with the dead so late?
sentences.ko: 이 밤늦게 죽은 이들 곁에 있는 자가 누구냐?

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw: Here’s one, a friend, and one that knows you well.

sentences.en: Here is someone, a friend who knows you well.
sentences.ko: 여기 있습니다. 신부님을 잘 아는 친구입니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Bliss be upon you. Tell me, good my friend,
What torch is yond that vainly lends his light
To grubs and eyeless skulls? As I discern,
It burneth in the Capels’ monument.

sentences.en: God bless you.
sentences.ko: 하나님의 축복이 있기를.

sentences.en: Tell me, my friend, what torch is that over there?
sentences.ko: 말해 다오, 친구여, 저기 저 횃불은 무엇이냐?

sentences.en: It uselessly gives light to worms and eyeless skulls.
sentences.ko: 벌레와 눈 없는 해골에게 헛되이 빛을 비추고 있구나.

sentences.en: I see it burning in the Capulets' tomb.
sentences.ko: 캐퓰릿의 무덤에서 타오르는 게 보이는군.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
It doth so, holy sir, and there’s my master,
One that you love.

sentences.en: It does, holy sir, and there is my master, someone you love.
sentences.ko: 그렇습니다, 신부님. 저기 신부님이 아끼시는 제 주인님이 계십니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: Who is it?

sentences.en: Who is it?
sentences.ko: 누구냐?

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw: Romeo.

sentences.en: Romeo.
sentences.ko: 로미오입니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: How long hath he been there?

sentences.en: How long has he been there?
sentences.ko: 거기 들어간 지 얼마나 되었느냐?

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw: Full half an hour.

sentences.en: For half an hour.
sentences.ko: 30분 정도 되었습니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: Go with me to the vault.

sentences.en: Go with me to the vault.
sentences.ko: 나와 함께 지하 묘실로 가자.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
I dare not, sir;
My master knows not but I am gone hence,
And fearfully did menace me with death
If I did stay to look on his intents.

sentences.en: I do not dare, sir.
sentences.ko: 감히 그럴 수 없습니다, 신부님.

sentences.en: My master thinks I have gone away.
sentences.ko: 주인님은 제가 떠난 줄 알고 계십니다.

sentences.en: He threatened to kill me if I stayed to watch what he was doing.
sentences.ko: 주인님이 하시는 일을 지켜보려고 남으면 죽이겠다고 하셨습니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Stay then, I’ll go alone. Fear comes upon me.
O, much I fear some ill unlucky thing.

sentences.en: Stay then, I will go alone.
sentences.ko: 그럼 너는 남고, 내가 혼자 가겠다.

sentences.en: Fear comes over me.
sentences.ko: 두려움이 밀려오는구나.

sentences.en: I am afraid something terrible has happened.
sentences.ko: 무언가 끔찍한 일이 일어난 것 같아 걱정된다.

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
As I did sleep under this yew tree here,
I dreamt my master and another fought,
And that my master slew him.

sentences.en: While I slept under this yew tree, I dreamed my master and another person fought.
sentences.ko: 이 주목나무 아래에서 잠들었을 때, 주인님과 다른 사람이 싸우는 꿈을 꾸었습니다.

sentences.en: In my dream, my master killed him.
sentences.ko: 꿈속에서 주인님이 그 사람을 죽였습니다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw: Romeo!

sentences.en: Romeo!
sentences.ko: 로미오!

raw: Advances.

sentences.en: Friar Lawrence moves forward.
sentences.ko: 로런스 신부가 앞으로 나아간다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Alack, alack, what blood is this which stains
The stony entrance of this sepulchre?
What mean these masterless and gory swords
To lie discolour’d by this place of peace?

sentences.en: Oh no, oh no.
sentences.ko: 안 돼, 안 돼.

sentences.en: What blood is this?
sentences.ko: 이 피는 뭐지?

sentences.en: It stains the stone entrance of this tomb.
sentences.ko: 무덤 입구 돌에 피가 묻어 있다.

sentences.en: Why do these bloody swords lie here, without their owners, in this place of peace?
sentences.ko: 평화로운 이곳에 왜 주인도 없는 피 묻은 칼들이 놓여 있는 거지?

raw: Enters the monument.

sentences.en: Friar Lawrence enters the family tomb.
sentences.ko: 로런스 신부가 가문의 무덤으로 들어간다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
Romeo! O, pale! Who else? What, Paris too?
And steep’d in blood? Ah what an unkind hour
Is guilty of this lamentable chance?
The lady stirs.

sentences.en: Romeo! Oh, he is pale!
sentences.ko: 로미오! 오, 얼굴이 창백해!

sentences.en: Who else? Is it Paris too?
sentences.ko: 또 누구지? 패리스도 여기 있는 건가?

sentences.en: Are they both covered in blood?
sentences.ko: 둘 다 피로 뒤덮여 있나?

sentences.en: What cruel hour caused this sad event?
sentences.ko: 어떤 잔인한 시간이 이 슬픈 일을 불러왔단 말인가?

sentences.en: The lady is waking.
sentences.ko: 아가씨가 깨어나는구나.

raw: Juliet wakes and stirs.

sentences.en: Juliet wakes and moves.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 깨어나 움직인다.

speaker: JULIET
raw:
O comfortable Friar, where is my lord?
I do remember well where I should be,
And there I am. Where is my Romeo?

sentences.en: Dear Friar!
sentences.ko: 신부님!

sentences.en: Where is my lord?
sentences.ko: 제 남편은 어디 있어요?

sentences.en: I remember well where I should be.
sentences.ko: 제가 어디에 있어야 하는지 잘 기억해요.

sentences.en: And I am there.
sentences.ko: 그리고 저는 그곳에 있어요.

sentences.en: Where is my Romeo?
sentences.ko: 제 로미오는 어디 있어요?

raw: Noise within.

sentences.en: There is a noise nearby.
sentences.ko: 근처에서 소리가 들린다.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
I hear some noise. Lady, come from that nest
Of death, contagion, and unnatural sleep.
A greater power than we can contradict
Hath thwarted our intents. Come, come away.
Thy husband in thy bosom there lies dead;
And Paris too. Come, I’ll dispose of thee
Among a sisterhood of holy nuns.
Stay not to question, for the watch is coming.
Come, go, good Juliet. I dare no longer stay.

sentences.en: I hear some noise.
sentences.ko: 소리가 들리는구나.

sentences.en: My lady, come out from that nest of death, sickness, and unnatural sleep.
sentences.ko: 아가씨, 죽음과 병과 부자연스러운 잠의 둥지에서 나오너라.

sentences.en: A greater power than we can resist has stopped our plans, so come, let us leave now.
sentences.ko: 우리가 맞설 수 없는 더 큰 힘이 우리 계획을 막았으니, 자, 어서 떠나자.

sentences.en: Your husband lies dead in your arms and Paris is also dead.
sentences.ko: 네 남편은 네 품에 죽어 있고, 패리스도 죽었다.

sentences.en: Come, I will take you to a group of holy nuns.
sentences.ko: 자, 너를 거룩한 수녀들에게 데려다주마.

sentences.en: Do not stop to ask questions because the guards are coming.
sentences.ko: 야경꾼들이 오고 있으니 멈춰서 묻지 마라.

sentences.en: Come, go, good Juliet, as I dare not stay any longer.
sentences.ko: 자, 가자, 착한 줄리엣. 나는 더 머무를 수가 없구나.

speaker: JULIET
raw: Go, get thee hence, for I will not away.

sentences.en: Go away now, for I will not leave.
sentences.ko: 가세요. 저는 여기를 떠나지 않을 거예요.

raw: Exit Friar Lawrence.

speaker: JULIET
raw:
What’s here? A cup clos’d in my true love’s hand?
Poison, I see, hath been his timeless end.
O churl. Drink all, and left no friendly drop
To help me after? I will kiss thy lips.
Haply some poison yet doth hang on them,
To make me die with a restorative.

sentences.en: What is here?
sentences.ko: 이게 뭐지?

sentences.en: Is this a cup in my true love's hand?
sentences.ko: 내 사랑의 손에 잔이?

sentences.en: I see that poison was his final end.
sentences.ko: 독약이 그의 마지막이었구나.

sentences.en: You greedy thing!
sentences.ko: 욕심쟁이!

sentences.en: You drank everything and left no drop for me to drink after you.
sentences.ko: 당신이 다 마셔 버리고 나 마시라고 한 방울도 안 남겼구나.

sentences.en: I will kiss your lips.
sentences.ko: 당신 입술에 입 맞출래.

sentences.en: Perhaps some poison is still on them.
sentences.ko: 아직 독이 남아 있을지도 모른다.

sentences.en: It might let me die, and cure my pain.
sentences.ko: 그 독이 나를 죽게 해서 이 고통을 끝내 줄지도 몰라.

raw: Kisses him.

sentences.en: Juliet kisses him.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 그에게 키스한다.

speaker: JULIET
raw: Thy lips are warm!

sentences.en: Your lips are warm!
sentences.ko: 당신 입술이 따뜻해!

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw: Lead, boy. Which way?

sentences.en: Lead the way, boy.
sentences.ko: 앞장서라, 얘야.

sentences.en: Which way?
sentences.ko: 어느 쪽이냐?

speaker: JULIET
raw: Yea, noise? Then I’ll be brief. O happy dagger.

sentences.en: What, a noise? Then I will be quick. Oh, happy dagger!
sentences.ko: 뭐지, 소리가? 그럼 서둘러야겠다. 오, 반가운 단검아!

raw: Snatching Romeo’s dagger.

sentences.en: Juliet grabs Romeo's dagger.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 로미오의 단검을 잡는다.

speaker: JULIET
raw: This is thy sheath.

sentences.en: My body is your sheath now.
sentences.ko: 이제 내 몸이 네 칼집이다.

raw: stabs herself

sentences.en: Juliet stabs herself.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 자신을 찌른다.

speaker: JULIET
raw: There rest, and let me die.

sentences.en: Rest there, and let me die.
sentences.ko: 거기 머물러라, 그리고 나를 죽게 해 다오.

raw: Falls on Romeo’s body and dies.

sentences.en: Juliet falls on Romeo's body and dies.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣이 로미오의 몸 위로 쓰러지며 숨을 거둔다.

raw: Enter Watch with the Page of Paris.

sentences.en: The watchmen enter with Paris's page.
sentences.ko: 야경꾼들이 패리스의 시동과 함께 들어온다.

speaker: PAGE
raw: This is the place. There, where the torch doth burn.

sentences.en: This is the place.
sentences.ko: 이곳입니다.

sentences.en: It is there, where the torch burns.
sentences.ko: 횃불이 타오르는 저곳입니다.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw:
The ground is bloody. Search about the churchyard.
Go, some of you, whoe’er you find attach.

sentences.en: The ground is bloody.
sentences.ko: 바닥이 피투성이다.

sentences.en: Search around the churchyard.
sentences.ko: 교회 마당을 샅샅이 뒤져라.

sentences.en: Go, some of you, and arrest whoever you find.
sentences.ko: 몇은 가서, 누구든 보이는 대로 붙잡아라.

raw: Exeunt some of the Watch.

sentences.en: Some of the watchmen leave.
sentences.ko: 일부 야경꾼들이 떠난다.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw:
Pitiful sight! Here lies the County slain,
And Juliet bleeding, warm, and newly dead,
Who here hath lain this two days buried.
Go tell the Prince; run to the Capulets.
Raise up the Montagues, some others search.

sentences.en: What a sad sight! The Count lies here killed.
sentences.ko: 참혹한 광경이다! 백작님이 여기 살해되어 쓰러져 계신다.

sentences.en: Juliet is bleeding and warm, and she is newly dead.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣은 피를 흘리며 아직 따뜻하다. 방금 숨을 거두었다.

sentences.en: She has been buried here for two days.
sentences.ko: 그 아가씨는 이틀 전에 여기 묻혔는데.

sentences.en: Go tell the Prince, run to the Capulets, and wake up the Montagues.
sentences.ko: 가서 영주님께 알려라. 캐퓰릿 댁으로 달려가고, 몬태규 댁 사람들도 깨워라.

sentences.en: Some others search the area.
sentences.ko: 나머지는 주변을 수색해라.

raw: Exeunt others of the Watch.

sentences.en: Other watchmen leave.
sentences.ko: 다른 야경꾼들이 떠난다.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw:
We see the ground whereon these woes do lie,
But the true ground of all these piteous woes
We cannot without circumstance descry.

sentences.en: We see the ground where these tragedies happen.
sentences.ko: 이 비극이 벌어진 땅은 보이지만

sentences.en: But we cannot see the real reason for all this sadness.
sentences.ko: 이 모든 슬픔의 진짜 이유는 보이지 않는다.

sentences.en: We cannot know the cause without more information.
sentences.ko: 더 많은 정보 없이는 그 원인을 알 길이 없다.

raw: Re-enter some of the Watch with Balthasar.

sentences.en: Some watchmen come back with Balthasar.
sentences.ko: 몇몇 야경꾼들이 발타자르와 함께 돌아온다.

speaker: SECOND WATCH
raw: Here’s Romeo’s man. We found him in the churchyard.

sentences.en: Here is Romeo's man.
sentences.ko: 로미오의 하인을 데려왔어.

sentences.en: We found him in the churchyard.
sentences.ko: 교회 마당에서 그를 찾아냈어.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw: Hold him in safety till the Prince come hither.

sentences.en: Keep him safe until the Prince comes here.
sentences.ko: 영주님이 오실 때까지 잘 붙잡아 둬.

raw: Re-enter others of the Watch with Friar Lawrence.

sentences.en: Other watchmen come back with Friar Lawrence.
sentences.ko: 다른 야경꾼들이 로런스 신부를 데리고 돌아온다.

speaker: THIRD WATCH
raw:
Here is a Friar that trembles, sighs, and weeps.
We took this mattock and this spade from him
As he was coming from this churchyard side.

sentences.en: Here is a friar who trembles, sighs, and cries.
sentences.ko: 벌벌 떨고 한숨 쉬며 우는 신부를 데려왔어.

sentences.en: We took this pickaxe and this spade from him.
sentences.ko: 이 사람한테서 곡괭이와 삽을 빼앗았어.

sentences.en: He was coming from this side of the churchyard.
sentences.ko: 교회 마당 이쪽에서 오고 있었어.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw: A great suspicion. Stay the Friar too.

sentences.en: This is very suspicious.
sentences.ko: 이건 매우 수상해.

sentences.en: Keep the friar here too.
sentences.ko: 신부도 여기 붙잡아 둬.

raw: Enter the Prince and Attendants.

sentences.en: The Prince and his attendants enter.
sentences.ko: 영주와 수행원들이 들어온다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
What misadventure is so early up,
That calls our person from our morning’s rest?

sentences.en: What disaster is up so early, that it calls me from my morning rest?
sentences.ko: 무슨 재앙이 이리 일찍 일어나 내 아침잠을 깨우느냐?

raw: Enter Capulet, Lady Capulet and others.

sentences.en: Capulet, Lady Capulet, and others enter.
sentences.ko: 캐퓰릿, 캐퓰릿 부인, 그리고 다른 이들이 들어온다.

speaker: CAPULET
raw: What should it be that they so shriek abroad?

sentences.en: Why are they screaming outside?
sentences.ko: 밖에서 왜들 저리 소리를 지르는 거요?

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw:
O the people in the street cry Romeo,
Some Juliet, and some Paris, and all run
With open outcry toward our monument.

sentences.en: The people in the street are crying out, some shouting Romeo, some Juliet, and some Paris.
sentences.ko: 거리의 사람들이 울부짖고 있어요. 어떤 이들은 로미오, 어떤 이들은 줄리엣, 또 어떤 이들은 패리스를 외치고 있고요.

sentences.en: They all run toward our family tomb with loud cries.
sentences.ko: 그들이 모두 큰 소리를 지르며 우리 가문의 무덤으로 달려가고 있어요.

speaker: PRINCE
raw: What fear is this which startles in our ears?

sentences.en: What fear is this that startles our ears?
sentences.ko: 우리 귀를 놀라게 하는 이 두려운 소리는 무엇이냐?

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw:
Sovereign, here lies the County Paris slain,
And Romeo dead, and Juliet, dead before,
Warm and new kill’d.

sentences.en: Your Highness, Count Paris lies here killed.
sentences.ko: 영주님, 패리스 백작님이 여기 살해되어 쓰러져 계십니다.

sentences.en: Romeo is dead too.
sentences.ko: 로미오도 죽었습니다.

sentences.en: And Juliet, who was dead before, is warm and newly killed.
sentences.ko: 그리고 전에 죽었던 줄리엣이 아직 따뜻한 채로 방금 목숨을 잃었습니다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw: Search, seek, and know how this foul murder comes.

sentences.en: Search and find out how this terrible murder happened.
sentences.ko: 조사해서 이 끔찍한 살인 사건이 어떻게 일어났는지 알아내라.

speaker: FIRST WATCH
raw:
Here is a Friar, and slaughter’d Romeo’s man,
With instruments upon them fit to open
These dead men’s tombs.

sentences.en: Here is a friar, and the servant of murdered Romeo.
sentences.ko: 여기 신부 한 사람과 살해된 로미오의 하인이 있습니다.

sentences.en: They have tools fit to open these dead men's tombs.
sentences.ko: 이 무덤들을 열 만한 도구를 가지고 있었습니다.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
O heaven! O wife, look how our daughter bleeds!
This dagger hath mista’en, for lo, his house
Is empty on the back of Montague,
And it mis-sheathed in my daughter’s bosom.

sentences.en: Oh heaven!
sentences.ko: 오, 하늘이시여!

sentences.en: My wife, look how our daughter bleeds!
sentences.ko: 부인, 우리 딸이 피 흘리는 걸 보시오!

sentences.en: This dagger went to the wrong place.
sentences.ko: 이 단검이 자리를 잘못 찾았구려.

sentences.en: Look, its sheath hangs empty on the back of Montague's son.
sentences.ko: 보시오, 칼집은 몬태규 아들의 등에 빈 채로 매달려 있는데

sentences.en: Instead, it is sheathed in my daughter's chest.
sentences.ko: 단검은 내 딸의 가슴에 꽂혀 있소.

speaker: LADY CAPULET
raw:
O me! This sight of death is as a bell
That warns my old age to a sepulchre.

sentences.en: Oh me!
sentences.ko: 아이고!

sentences.en: This sight of death is like a bell.
sentences.ko: 이 죽음의 광경이 종소리 같아요.

sentences.en: It warns me that my old age is near the tomb.
sentences.ko: 내 늙은 몸이 무덤 가까이 왔다고 알리는 것 같아요.

raw: Enter Montague and others.

sentences.en: Montague and others enter.
sentences.ko: 몬태규와 다른 이들이 들어온다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
Come, Montague, for thou art early up,
To see thy son and heir more early down.

sentences.en: Come, Montague.
sentences.ko: 이리 오시오, 몬태규.

sentences.en: You are up early, to see your son and heir laid down even earlier.
sentences.ko: 그대는 일찍 일어났구려, 아들이자 후계자가 더 일찍 눕는 것을 보려고.

speaker: MONTAGUE
raw:
Alas, my liege, my wife is dead tonight.
Grief of my son’s exile hath stopp’d her breath.
What further woe conspires against mine age?

sentences.en: Alas, my lord.
sentences.ko: 아아, 영주님.

sentences.en: My wife died tonight.
sentences.ko: 제 부인이 오늘 밤 세상을 떠났습니다.

sentences.en: The grief of my son's exile stopped her breath.
sentences.ko: 아들의 추방으로 인한 슬픔이 그녀의 숨을 멎게 했습니다.

sentences.en: What other sadness will happen to me in my old age?
sentences.ko: 노년에 저에게 또 어떤 슬픔이 닥치겠습니까?

speaker: PRINCE
raw: Look, and thou shalt see.

sentences.en: Look, and you will see.
sentences.ko: 보시오, 그러면 알게 될 것이오.

speaker: MONTAGUE
raw:
O thou untaught! What manners is in this,
To press before thy father to a grave?

sentences.en: Oh, you bad-mannered boy!
sentences.ko: 오, 이 버릇없는 녀석아!

sentences.en: Where are your manners, rushing to the grave before your father?
sentences.ko: 아비보다 먼저 무덤으로 달려가다니, 그런 법이 어디 있느냐?

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
Seal up the mouth of outrage for a while,
Till we can clear these ambiguities,
And know their spring, their head, their true descent,
And then will I be general of your woes,
And lead you even to death. Meantime forbear,
And let mischance be slave to patience.
Bring forth the parties of suspicion.

sentences.en: Stop all shouting for a moment because we need to clear up these confusing facts.
sentences.ko: 잠시 모두 소리를 멈춰라. 이 뒤엉킨 사실들을 밝혀야 한다.

sentences.en: We must find the source and the cause of this crime.
sentences.ko: 이 범죄의 근원과 원인을 찾아야 한다.

sentences.en: Then I will lead you in your mourning, even to death.
sentences.ko: 그 후에 내가 너희의 슬픔을 이끌겠다. 죽음에 이르기까지라도.

sentences.en: In the meantime, be patient and let patience control this bad luck.
sentences.ko: 그동안은 참고, 인내로 이 불운을 다스려라.

sentences.en: Bring out the suspects.
sentences.ko: 용의자들을 데려와라.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
I am the greatest, able to do least,
Yet most suspected, as the time and place
Doth make against me, of this direful murder.
And here I stand, both to impeach and purge
Myself condemned and myself excus’d.

sentences.en: I am the most suspected, though I was able to do the least.
sentences.ko: 제가 한 일은 가장 적은데도, 가장 의심을 받습니다.

sentences.en: The time and place make me look guilty of this terrible murder.
sentences.ko: 시간과 장소로 보아 제가 이 끔찍한 살인에 가담한 것처럼 보입니다.

sentences.en: I stand here both to accuse myself and to explain myself.
sentences.ko: 저 자신을 고발하고, 또 해명하기 위해 여기 섰습니다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw: Then say at once what thou dost know in this.

sentences.en: Then tell me at once what you know about this.
sentences.ko: 그럼 그대가 아는 것을 당장 말하라.

speaker: FRIAR LAWRENCE
raw:
I will be brief, for my short date of breath
Is not so long as is a tedious tale.
Romeo, there dead, was husband to that Juliet,
And she, there dead, that Romeo’s faithful wife.
I married them; and their stol’n marriage day
Was Tybalt’s doomsday, whose untimely death
Banish’d the new-made bridegroom from this city;
For whom, and not for Tybalt, Juliet pin’d.
You, to remove that siege of grief from her,
Betroth’d, and would have married her perforce
To County Paris. Then comes she to me,
And with wild looks, bid me devise some means
To rid her from this second marriage,
Or in my cell there would she kill herself.
Then gave I her, so tutored by my art,
A sleeping potion, which so took effect
As I intended, for it wrought on her
The form of death. Meantime I writ to Romeo
That he should hither come as this dire night
To help to take her from her borrow’d grave,
Being the time the potion’s force should cease.
But he which bore my letter, Friar John,
Was stay’d by accident; and yesternight
Return’d my letter back. Then all alone
At the prefixed hour of her waking
Came I to take her from her kindred’s vault,
Meaning to keep her closely at my cell
Till I conveniently could send to Romeo.
But when I came, some minute ere the time
Of her awaking, here untimely lay
The noble Paris and true Romeo dead.
She wakes; and I entreated her come forth
And bear this work of heaven with patience.
But then a noise did scare me from the tomb;
And she, too desperate, would not go with me,
But, as it seems, did violence on herself.
All this I know; and to the marriage
Her Nurse is privy. And if ought in this
Miscarried by my fault, let my old life
Be sacrific’d, some hour before his time,
Unto the rigour of severest law.

sentences.en: I will be brief, because my short life is not long enough for a boring story.
sentences.ko: 제게 남은 짧은 생은 지루한 이야기를 할 만큼 길지 않으니, 짧게 말씀드리겠습니다.

sentences.en: Romeo, dead there, was the husband of that Juliet, and she, dead there, was Romeo's faithful wife.
sentences.ko: 저기 죽어 있는 로미오는 저 줄리엣의 남편이었고, 저기 죽은 줄리엣은 로미오의 충실한 아내였습니다.

sentences.en: I married them, and their secret wedding day was Tybalt's last day.
sentences.ko: 제가 두 사람을 결혼시켰으며, 그들의 비밀스러운 결혼식 날이 바로 티볼트가 죽은 날이었습니다.

sentences.en: His early death forced the new groom to leave this city.
sentences.ko: 티볼트의 때 이른 죽음 때문에 새신랑은 이 도시를 떠나야 했습니다.

sentences.en: Juliet grieved for him, not for Tybalt.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣은 티볼트가 아니라 그를 위해 슬퍼했습니다.

sentences.en: To cure her grief, you promised her to Count Paris and would have forced her to marry him.
sentences.ko: 그 슬픔을 달래려고 캐퓰릿 경께서 따님을 패리스 백작과 약혼시키고 억지로 결혼시키려 하셨습니다.

sentences.en: Then she came to me with a wild look.
sentences.ko: 그러자 그녀가 몹시 괴로워하며 저를 찾아왔습니다.

sentences.en: She asked me to find a way to stop this second marriage.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 이 두 번째 결혼을 막을 방법을 찾아달라고 요청했습니다.

sentences.en: She said she would kill herself in my cell if I did not help.
sentences.ko: 도와주지 않으면 제 수도실에서 자결하겠다고 말했습니다.

sentences.en: Then, using my knowledge of plants, I gave her a sleeping potion that worked exactly as I planned.
sentences.ko: 그래서 저는 약초에 대한 지식으로 잠드는 약을 주었고, 약은 제 뜻대로 정확히 들었습니다.

sentences.en: It made her look like death while I wrote to Romeo.
sentences.ko: 그 약 덕분에 제가 로미오에게 편지를 쓰는 동안 그녀는 죽은 것처럼 보였습니다.

sentences.en: I told him to come here tonight.
sentences.ko: 저는 그에게 오늘 밤 이곳으로 오라고 말했습니다.

sentences.en: He was to take her from her borrowed grave when the potion's power ended.
sentences.ko: 약효가 다하면 그가 빌린 무덤에서 그녀를 데려가기로 했습니다.

sentences.en: But Friar John, who carried my letter, was stopped by an accident and returned it last night.
sentences.ko: 하지만 제 편지를 가져가던 존 신부가 뜻밖의 일로 발이 묶여 어젯밤 편지를 도로 가져왔습니다.

sentences.en: Then I came alone at the planned time to take her from her family's vault.
sentences.ko: 그래서 저는 약속된 시간에 혼자 와서 가족의 지하 묘실에서 그녀를 데려오려 했습니다.

sentences.en: I planned to keep her in my cell until I could send word to Romeo.
sentences.ko: 로미오에게 소식을 전할 때까지 그녀를 제 수도실에 머물게 할 계획이었습니다.

sentences.en: But when I arrived just before she woke up, the noble Paris and true Romeo lay here dead.
sentences.ko: 하지만 그녀가 깨어나기 직전에 도착했을 때, 고귀한 패리스와 진정한 로미오가 이곳에 죽어 있었습니다.

sentences.en: She woke, and I asked her to come out and accept this act of heaven with patience.
sentences.ko: 그녀가 깨어나자 저는 밖으로 나와 하늘이 하신 이 일을 참고 받아들이자고 했습니다.

sentences.en: But then a noise scared me away from the tomb.
sentences.ko: 하지만 그때 소리가 들려 저는 무덤에서 멀리 물러나게 되었습니다.

sentences.en: She was too desperate to go with me.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 너무 절망해서 저와 함께 가려 하지 않았습니다.

sentences.en: It seems she killed herself.
sentences.ko: 그녀가 스스로 목숨을 끊은 것 같습니다.

sentences.en: That is all I know.
sentences.ko: 제가 아는 것은 여기까지입니다.

sentences.en: Her Nurse knows about the marriage.
sentences.ko: 유모도 결혼에 대해 알고 있습니다.

sentences.en: If anything went wrong because of my fault, let my old life be sacrificed to the harshest law.
sentences.ko: 제 잘못으로 일이 틀어졌다면, 이 늙은 목숨을 가장 엄한 법에 바치겠습니다.

sentences.en: Let it happen sooner than its time.
sentences.ko: 제 명이 다하기 전에 거두어 가십시오.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
We still have known thee for a holy man.
Where’s Romeo’s man? What can he say to this?

sentences.en: We have always known you as a holy man.
sentences.ko: 우리는 늘 그대를 거룩한 사람으로 알아 왔다.

sentences.en: Where is Romeo's man?
sentences.ko: 로미오의 하인은 어디 있느냐?

sentences.en: What can he say about this?
sentences.ko: 그는 이 일에 대해 무슨 말을 할 수 있느냐?

speaker: BALTHASAR
raw:
I brought my master news of Juliet’s death,
And then in post he came from Mantua
To this same place, to this same monument.
This letter he early bid me give his father,
And threaten’d me with death, going in the vault,
If I departed not, and left him there.

sentences.en: I brought my master news of Juliet's death.
sentences.ko: 제 주인님께 줄리엣의 죽음을 알렸습니다.

sentences.en: Then he rode fast from Mantua to this place, to this same tomb.
sentences.ko: 그러자 주인님은 만토바에서 이곳, 바로 이 무덤으로 급히 말을 달려오셨습니다.

sentences.en: He told me to give this letter to his father early in the morning.
sentences.ko: 주인님은 아침 일찍 이 편지를 아버님께 전하라고 하셨습니다.

sentences.en: Going into the tomb, he threatened to kill me if I did not leave him alone there.
sentences.ko: 무덤에 들어가시면서, 혼자 두고 떠나지 않으면 저를 죽이겠다고 하셨습니다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
Give me the letter, I will look on it.
Where is the County’s Page that rais’d the watch?
Sirrah, what made your master in this place?

sentences.en: Give me the letter. I will look at it.
sentences.ko: 편지를 내놔라. 내가 확인하겠다.

sentences.en: Where is the Count's page who called the watchmen?
sentences.ko: 야경꾼들을 부른 백작의 시동은 어디 있느냐?

sentences.en: You there, why did your master come to this place?
sentences.ko: 너, 네 주인은 왜 이곳에 온 것이냐?

speaker: PAGE
raw:
He came with flowers to strew his lady’s grave,
And bid me stand aloof, and so I did.
Anon comes one with light to ope the tomb,
And by and by my master drew on him,
And then I ran away to call the watch.

sentences.en: He came with flowers to scatter on his lady's grave.
sentences.ko: 주인님은 아가씨의 무덤에 뿌릴 꽃을 가지고 오셨습니다.

sentences.en: He told me to stand away, and I did so.
sentences.ko: 저더러 떨어져 있으라고 하셔서 그렇게 했습니다.

sentences.en: Soon someone came with a light to open the tomb.
sentences.ko: 곧 누군가 횃불을 들고 무덤을 열러 왔습니다.

sentences.en: Then my master drew his sword on him.
sentences.ko: 그러자 주인님이 그 사람에게 칼을 뽑으셨습니다.

sentences.en: Then I ran away to call the watchmen.
sentences.ko: 저는 야경꾼들을 부르기 위해 도망쳤습니다.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
This letter doth make good the Friar’s words,
Their course of love, the tidings of her death.
And here he writes that he did buy a poison
Of a poor ’pothecary, and therewithal
Came to this vault to die, and lie with Juliet.
Where be these enemies? Capulet, Montague,
See what a scourge is laid upon your hate,
That heaven finds means to kill your joys with love!
And I, for winking at your discords too,
Have lost a brace of kinsmen. All are punish’d.

sentences.en: This letter confirms the Friar's words.
sentences.ko: 이 편지는 신부의 말을 확인해 준다.

sentences.en: It tells of their love and the news of her death.
sentences.ko: 두 사람의 사랑과 그녀의 죽음 소식이 적혀 있다.

sentences.en: He writes here that he bought poison from a poor medicine seller.
sentences.ko: 가난한 약장수에게서 독약을 샀다고 여기 적었다.

sentences.en: He came to this vault to die and lie with Juliet.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣 곁에서 죽어 함께 눕기 위해 이 묘실에 온 것이다.

sentences.en: Where are these enemies? Capulet! Montague!
sentences.ko: 원수들은 어디 있느냐? 캐퓰릿! 몬태규!

sentences.en: Look at what a punishment is placed on your hatred.
sentences.ko: 너희의 증오가 어떤 벌을 받았는지 보아라.

sentences.en: Heaven found a way to kill your joys with love!
sentences.ko: 하늘은 사랑으로 너희의 기쁨을 죽일 방법을 찾아냈다!

sentences.en: And I, for ignoring your fights, have lost two relatives.
sentences.ko: 나 또한 너희 싸움을 눈감아 준 탓에 친척 둘을 잃었다.

sentences.en: All are punished.
sentences.ko: 모두가 벌을 받았다.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
O brother Montague, give me thy hand.
This is my daughter’s jointure, for no more
Can I demand.

sentences.en: Oh brother Montague, give me your hand.
sentences.ko: 오, 몬태규 형제, 손을 주시오.

sentences.en: This handshake is my daughter's wedding gift from you.
sentences.ko: 이 악수가 당신이 내 딸에게 주는 결혼 선물이오.

sentences.en: I can ask for nothing more.
sentences.ko: 더는 바랄 것이 없소.

speaker: MONTAGUE
raw:
But I can give thee more,
For I will raise her statue in pure gold,
That whiles Verona by that name is known,
There shall no figure at such rate be set
As that of true and faithful Juliet.

sentences.en: But I can give you more.
sentences.ko: 하지만 나는 더 드릴 수 있소.

sentences.en: I will make her statue out of pure gold.
sentences.ko: 순금으로 그 아이의 조각상을 세우겠소.

sentences.en: It will stand as long as Verona is called Verona.
sentences.ko: 베로나가 베로나라 불리는 한 그 조각상은 서 있을 것이오.

sentences.en: No statue will be worth as much as that of true and faithful Juliet.
sentences.ko: 진실하고 충실했던 줄리엣의 조각상만큼 귀한 조각상은 없을 것이오.

speaker: CAPULET
raw:
As rich shall Romeo’s by his lady’s lie,
Poor sacrifices of our enmity.

sentences.en: Romeo's statue will lie by his lady's, just as rich.
sentences.ko: 로미오의 조각상도 똑같이 화려하게 그 아내 곁에 누울 것이오.

sentences.en: They are poor sacrifices of our hatred.
sentences.ko: 우리 증오가 바친 가엾은 희생물들이오.

speaker: PRINCE
raw:
A glooming peace this morning with it brings;
The sun for sorrow will not show his head.
Go hence, to have more talk of these sad things.
Some shall be pardon’d, and some punished,
For never was a story of more woe
Than this of Juliet and her Romeo.

sentences.en: This morning brings a gloomy peace.
sentences.ko: 오늘 아침은 음울한 평화를 가져오는구나.

sentences.en: The sun will not show its face because of the sadness.
sentences.ko: 슬픔 때문에 태양도 얼굴을 내비치지 않을 것이다.

sentences.en: Go now, and we will talk more about these sad things.
sentences.ko: 이제 가서, 이 슬픈 일들을 더 이야기하자.

sentences.en: Some will be pardoned, and some punished.
sentences.ko: 용서받는 자도 있을 것이고 처벌받는 자도 있을 것이다.

sentences.en: No story was ever sadder than this story of Juliet and her Romeo.
sentences.ko: 줄리엣과 그녀의 로미오에 관한 이 이야기보다 더 슬픈 이야기는 없었다.

raw: Exeunt.
